journeys.name: Match Learner Information for Certificate Access
journeys.description: User provides their details step-by-step until their identity is verified and certificates are found.

journeys.name: Request Certificate Delivery
journeys.description: User requests delivery of a certificate by entering or selecting an address and confirming the request.

journeys.name: Send Certificate Sharing Link via Email
journeys.description: User sends a previously generated certificate sharing link via email and receives a confirmation.

journeys.name: Authorise and Access Your Certificates
journeys.description: User goes through the identity/ULN authorisation journey and lands on their certificates list.

journeys.name: Certificate Framework Actions
journeys.description: User visits their framework certificate and can share, download, or contact support.

journeys.name: Share a Framework Certificate
journeys.description: User generates or manages sharing links on their framework certificate.

journeys.name: Contact Support for a Framework Certificate
journeys.description: User raises a support request for a specific framework certificate and returns to view it.

journeys.name: Contact Support (General)
journeys.description: User raises a generic support request from their certificates list and returns.

journeys.name: Access Shared Framework Certificate and Download PDF
journeys.description: External user accesses a shared framework certificate and downloads the PDF.
